result.title: Conformal Fair Decoding for Large Language Model Recommenders
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate personalized recommendations without task-specific training, but changing a protected attribute while holding interaction history fixed can alter the semantic content of recommended items. We study fairness control when model weights and full-vocabulary logits are unavailable. We propose Fair- Rec, an item-level decoding framework that uses an offline-calibrated semantic-disparity threshold and controls candidate selection as recommendation lists are generated. A hard variant filters candidates against the threshold; a soft variant trades off candidate likelihood and disparity while adapting a penalty using observed violations. Under an explicit uniform enforceability assumption, we establish a pathwise O(1/T) upper bound on the excess empirical violation rate of the soft decoder. Experiments on MovieLens-1M and Amazon Movies & TV using Qwen3-8B and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct show that the soft variant lowers measured counterfactual disparity relative to zero- =shot recommendation, UP5, and FACTER, while retaining competitive HR@10 and NDCG@10.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究在无法访问模型权重与全词表 logits 条件下的推荐公平性控制，提出 Fair-Rec 解码框架：用离线校准的语义差异阈值在生成推荐列表时筛选候选，并给出软解码器经验违反率的上界，在 MovieLens-1M 与 Amazon 数据集上验证差异下降而排序指标保持竞争力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离线校准阈值 + 违规自适应惩罚」的生成期候选控制线索，可供核查是否能类比用于 latent 推理中的证据筛选或停止/切换决策，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或多模态表征。
